presets.name: Standard (Meshtastic default)
presets.summary: LongFast — the worldwide default. Works everywhere; best choice when your area has no organized mesh.

presets.name: Bay Area Mesh
presets.summary: MediumFast, slot 45, hop limit 6 (personal node) — bayme.sh recommended settings (updated Oct 2025). Suggested role: Client, or Client Mute in a vehicle.

presets.name: NYC Mesh (NYME.SH)
presets.summary: MediumSlow, slot 48, hop limit 7 (personal node) — nyme.sh recommended settings. Suggested role: Client Mute for handhelds, Client if stationary.

presets.name: NYC Mesh — Legacy (LongFast)
presets.summary: LongFast, slot 20 — nyme.sh legacy network. Often busier until the MediumSlow migration completes; use it to compare traffic.
